zap.intro: Take a photo of your notebook or paste text. Evklid makes you a quiz and flashcards.
zap.privacy: Only notes in the photo – no faces or names. We don't keep the photo.
zap.max: At most 5 pages at a time.
zap.pagesLeft: Pages this month: {left} of {limit} left. Every photo and every pasted text counts.
zap.check: Did I read it right? Fix anything that's wrong.
zap.pastePh: Paste or type your notes here …
zap.making: Finding the topics and preparing a quiz and flashcards …
zap.noTopics: I didn't find these topics on the learning path, so there is no quiz.
zap.quizHint: Tasks from Evklid's practice for these topics.
zap.wrong: Not correct. The right answer is marked.
zap.cardsAdded: The flashcards are in your Flashcards, in the set »{title}«.
zap.noCards: I can't make flashcards from these notes right now.
zap.printed: We don't keep the text of printed pages – only the topics and flashcards.
zap.printedNoCards: We don't keep the text of printed pages.
zap.empty: You have no saved notes yet.
zap.deleteAsk: Delete the notes »{title}« and their flashcards?
zap.errRead: I can't read this. Take the photo closer and in better light.

zap.errEmpty: I didn't find anything in the notes for a quiz or flashcards.
zap.errNoPhoto: Reading photos isn't available here. Paste the text.
zap.aiOff: I can't make flashcards right now (usage limit). The practice quiz still works.

vaja.title: Practice from a test or homework
vaja.teaser: Take a photo of a test or homework. Evklid finds what you're practising and gives you new, similar tasks.
vaja.intro: Evklid recognises what each task needs and gives you new tasks from its practice, from easier to harder. It doesn't solve your tasks.
vaja.privacy: No names or faces in the photo, please. We don't keep the photo or the text of the tasks.
vaja.pdfFail: I can't open this PDF. Take photos of the sheets or paste the text.
vaja.pastePh: Paste the tasks from your test or homework here …
vaja.finding: Reading the tasks and finding what you're practising …
vaja.listTitle: This is what I found on the sheet
vaja.listHint: Switch off tasks you don't want to practise. If the skill isn't right, choose another one.
vaja.unsure: I'm not quite sure – please check.
vaja.none: I don't have checked practice for this task yet – ask the tutor.
vaja.noneOn: Switch on at least one task with a skill.
vaja.ourTasks: The tasks come from Evklid's practice and are checked.
vaja.sessionIntro: New tasks for the skills on your sheet, from easier to harder.
vaja.errEmpty: I didn't find any tasks on the sheet. Take the photo closer or paste the text.
vaja.againHint: Keep practising the rest with »One more practice«.
vaja.unknown: I didn't recognise the skill – choose it yourself.
vaja.onlySi: For now only for Slovenian primary and secondary school.
vaja.tooFast: Too many sheets in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
vaja.expired: The task list has expired. Read the sheet again.
vaja.lengthHint: Skills chosen: {k}. With {n} tasks, not all of them get a turn.
